title: Agreement of complex and homotopy localization tensor maps
statement: For a commutative condensed coefficient ring and two internal cochain complexes, the lax tensorator of complex localization equals the homotopy localization tensorator evaluated on their images in the homotopy category.

source.place: Tag 06YU, localization of the signed total tensor; the canonical complex-to-homotopy quotient comparison.

proof.text: The homotopy quotient is strict monoidal. The comparison from its composite with homotopy localization to complex localization has identity components. Expanding the transported lax monoidal structure therefore identifies the complex localization tensorator with the homotopy localization tensorator.

proof_origin.place: The canonical strict monoidal homotopy quotient and the identity-component quotientCompQhIso, together with the transported lax monoidal structure.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientScalarTensor_complexLocalization
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    [∀ X : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleRingedComparison.modules Λ X)]
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (K L : CochainComplex (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ Z) ℤ) :
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q K L =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj K)
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj L)
